text_block_list.text:
The Takamatsunomiya Kinen is just around 
the corner. To put the finishing touches 
on Believe, today— I had prepared a very 
special training session.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Ah... You've arrived.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting. —Regarding the 
practice race, I look forward to working 
with you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
As the humblest member of the Glorious 
Family, I shall face you with everything I 
have.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, uh...! I will also do my absolute best 
to be of help!

The ones greeting me in their own unique 
ways were Daiichi Ruby and Nishino Flower.

Both of them were from the senior 
generation, and... like Believe, were 
speedster Umamusume who had conquered the 
Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No. Since you went to the trouble of 
visiting so many times, we were able to 
thoroughly coordinate our schedule.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So many people came to see me, too...! 
That's why I was able to prepare so much 
for today.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I believe I can give you my full support 
heading into Believe-san's Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...This is the fruit of your hard work, 
isn't it, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Miss Ruby, Miss Flower. Once again, I look 
forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Please allow me to put everything I have 
into getting you ready for the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —From here on, it's my job.

Afterward, the other Umamusume who had 
been invited also gathered, and everything 
was ready for the mock race.

Gripping my stopwatch tightly, I watched 
steadily from outside the track. And 
then—the gates opened.

After getting off to a great start, 
Believe takes the lead of the front pack. 
That means in the battle for position 
against Nishino Flower, who also runs near 
the front—

A 1,200m race is over in an instant. I 
quickly scan the board to check the first 
600m split.

"Seeing such a fast time, I reflexively 
clench my fist. Believe's specialty is 
'grinding down the competition with a high 
pace.' In other words—"

Whether you can accelerate smoothly right 
from the start and set a high pace is 
crucial.

Everyone knows Believe's stamina. 
Considering the possibility that she won't 
slow down at all, they have no choice but 
to keep up, even at a high pace.

Even with Daiichi Ruby as the opponent, 
now a chance of victory comes into 
sight...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, hah... Haaah...!!

Catching up to the fading front-runner at 
the 4th corner, Believe took the lead. And 
onto the final stretch, the pack launches 
their sprint!
However—!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *huff*—!

"The sustained pressure is taking its 
toll! The gap is steadily closing... but 
she just can't seem to catch up to Believe 
in the lead!"

Having set such a high pace throughout the 
race, her legs must be near their limit... 
And yet, Believe isn't falling behind.

This perseverance, and the stamina born 
from it—that is the true essence of her 
speed...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Ngh, *pant*, *gasp*, *pant*, *gasp*—...!
choice_data_list:
Hang in there, Believe! Dig in and hold 
on!

Hang in there, Believe! Hold on till the 
end!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Aaaahhhh!!

And Believe held on brilliantly, claiming 
victory in the mock race—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Haa, ngh...!! Haa... haa... haa...—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Ngh, wheeeew...
choice_data_list: Good work, Believe! That was awesome...!
Good work, Believe! That was great...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san. —Yes. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"With this... we're all set for the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen."
choice_data_list: Yeah. Now just get some good rest!
Yeah. Make sure to get plenty of rest now!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, are you done for the day...? Well 
then, Believe-san, want to head out 
together now?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. That should be just in 
time for the shopping meetup.
choice_data_list: Hmm, did you make a promise or something?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Ehehe, you see, today... we're 
throwing a "send-off party" for 
Believe-san!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Otherwise known as a pajama party!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty then♪ Pouring in all our "Do your 
best~" feelings for Believe-san's 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Cheeeers♡

text_block_list.name: Chan & Grand
text_block_list.text: "Cheers!"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Cheers.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much. ................

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Excuse me. I was just a little 
surprised to see you here, Ruby-san."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Judging by how you look in class, you 
always seem terribly busy, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"I won't deny that I'm busy, but Curren 
shared today's plans with me two weeks in 
advance, so there is no issue."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
We had more than ample time for 
adjustments. That was all thanks to 
Curren-san's hard work.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, you flatter me♪ Curren just really 
wanted to have a chat with eve~ryone like 
this at least once!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Let's have a whole bunch of chatter today 
with our glamorous sprinter girls♡

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Accompanied by all these... carrot cookies 
that Flower-chan baked us a buuunch of♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, they baked pretty well, so... I'd 
be really happy if you enjoyed them.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much. Down the hatch.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Ma-chan also really, really wanted to 
talk with Believe-san."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Because I've heard all about it from 
Kobujiro-san, a cat who makes his home in 
the residential area just a bit further 
in.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...A residential area tucked away in the 
back? Ah—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
The place where Harue-san and the others 
live? Come to think of it... yeah, there 
was a stray cat...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, me too! I want to talk too! I've 
been wondering about it for the longest 
time...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Believe-senpai, you have a whole bunch of 
personal rules, don't you!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I occasionally hear about how things are 
in your room from Lala-senpai, but—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"There were so many fascinating things! 
Like, 'don't go far if swallows fly low,' 
or 'check the direction if a dog is 
barking'!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Rather than a personal rule, it's a 
teaching. From my grandparents."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It means that when swallows fly low, it is 
likely to rain—
And with that, the lively night wore on—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...The other girls have gone to sleep, 
haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
The overnight stay request has already 
been filed, so there shouldn't be any 
issue.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"—By the way, Believe-san. Your 
performance in the mock race earlier was 
truly splendid."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Huh... Ah. ...Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I feel deeply mortified that I failed to 
catch up to your back, but—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
However, judging by your performance on 
the track, you are in truly admirable 
form. You must have honed your skills 
extensively.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Believe-san, you—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: She has tuned herself up wonderfully.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"The Takamatsunomiya Kinen is a race with 
a profoundly sacred and weighty meaning, 
even to us of the 'Noble Clan.'"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"However, as you are now, you are truly 
worthy of being called the victor."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Whether that's really the case or not—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —I'll prove it through my work.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
With this running form, honed to 
perfection.
